# Deepfield

Deepfield is a dark, sci-fi editorial theme that treats notes like a mission-control field guide, with wide-tracked monospace headers, square corners and a single blue accent. Twenty color palettes, including eight planet spectra, can be switched live, and the theme adds custom callouts, HUD panels and distinct task-state glyphs while keeping its accents in both dark and light modes.

![Deepfield screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nbost130/deepfield/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue

    name:   "Deepfield"
    author: "Nathan Bost"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/nbost130/deepfield"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nbost130/deepfield/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

Switch live among 20 color palettes (including eight planet spectra), add custom callouts and HUD panels, get distinct task-state glyphs, and keep accents in both dark and light modes."
}
```
